title: Heard
claim: Product Hunt: Heard — Give Claude Code and Codex a voice
why_good: Adds voice I/O to Claude Code and Codex — hands-free coding is a real, sticky workflow if latency and accuracy hold.
value: Prosumer subscription for devs who want to code by voice; upsell teams and accessibility use-cases.
risk: The agent vendors can add native voice any release; a thin voice wrapper needs speed + UX to survive.
evidence: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Heard —— 给 Claude Code 和 Codex 加上语音。
zh.why_good: 给 Claude Code/Codex 加语音输入输出——若延迟和准确度过关,免手写代码是个真实且黏的工作流。
zh.value: 给想用语音写代码的开发者卖专业订阅;向团队和无障碍场景 upsell。
zh.risk: agent 厂商随时能加原生语音;薄语音封装要靠速度 + 体验才能活。
